notes:
New

  • Theme Preview settings menu: every theme rendered as a card in its own colors, grouped by genre. Clicking a card live-previews it across all open Scorpious187 windows; Save & Apply sets it as the Family Theme, Cancel (or closing) reverts. Also reachable via api.theming.openPicker().

Fixed (also shipped in 0.2.1)

  • The Custom Theme Editor failed to open with Template part "editor" must render a single HTML element.
